descrizione: Rosso e oro su crema, minimal e pulito, angoli morbidi, con ghirlanda di lucine. Segue il modo chiaro o scuro del dispositivo.
css: /* Natale – rosso e oro */body{padding-top:22px}body::before{content:"";position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:22px;z-index:7;pointer-events:none;background:url(data:image/svg+xml;base64,) repeat-x 0 0/96px 22px;animation:nat-tw 3.4s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes nat-tw{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.8}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){body::before{animation:none}}@media print{body::before{display:none}body{padding-top:0}}.top{top:22px}::selection{background:var(--ac2);color:#2B1A17}.card,.tile,.acc,.dlg{box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(43,26,23,.06)}.tile{border-left-width:3px}.tile:nth-child(odd){border-left-color:var(--ac)}.tile:hover{border-color:var(--ac2);transform:translateY(-1px);transition:transform .12s,border-color .12s}.btn{border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;padding-left:16px;padding-right:16px}.btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--ac);border:1.5px solid var(--ac)}.btn.ghost:hover{background:var(--ac);color:var(--bg)}input[type=text]:focus,input[type=password]:focus,input[type=search]:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--ac);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(179,32,42,.2)}th{color:var(--mu);font-weight:700}h1,h2{letter-spacing:-.01em}.clock{border-top:2px solid var(--ac2);border-left:2px solid var(--ac2)}.clock::before{content:"\1F384  "}*{scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--ac2) transparent}
